instructions_to_main_agent: Use the 'Organic & Earthy' color palette. Do not use default Tailwind blues or grays.
Implement the 'Manrope' font for all headings. Import it from Google Fonts.
Use 'Public Sans' for body text. Import it from Google Fonts.
For the Dashboard, use the 'Bento Grid' layout defined in layout.grid.dashboard.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit').
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Use solid white with shadow.
Use the provided image URLs for the login page and placeholders.
Follow the spacing guidelines strictly. Use p-8 or p-12 for main containers.
Use Shadcn components but override the styles with the classes defined in components section.
For the Agreement List, use a dense table layout with clear status badges.
Implement a 'Warning' state for agreements expiring within 30 days using the Accent color.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs. Use the specific colors and fonts provided.
Create depth with subtle borders and shadows, not just flat colors.
Ensure all text is legible against its background.
Use micro-interactions (hover states) for all clickable elements.
Do not use emoji icons. Use Lucide React icons.
